items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: so the guys in the original horn section, I went to Indiana with Larry Williams and Gary Grant

ctx.x: I’m sure it’s excellent, and it’s a blessing to have that group of musicians who you’d have to go out of your way to get someone who wasn’t cutting it.

Yes. Yeah, no, the guys can play anything that you’re going to write, and you know you just, for me I have to kind of, because I’m not playing and we’re not playing with — so the guys in the original horn section, I went to Indiana with Larry Williams and Gary Grant, when we were living in Hawaii Gary Grant came over to Hawaii and we were together in Hawaii before we were in L.A. for four years we were in Hawaii before that. So we’ve known each other for 52 years, Gary. Larry Williams has been 55 years, and Bill…
Okay. Well I really appreciate your time today and I should mention that I see that you’re a Lakers fan.
